chunks: Hell, where they will roast in the fire? And what an evil repository!

key_terms.الْقَرَارُ: The dwelling / repository / place of residence
key_terms.جَهَنَّمَ: Hell, a specific name for the fire of the Hereafter
key_terms.يَصْلَوْنَهَا: They will roast or burn in it

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the nature of Hell as a dwelling place?
ai.summary: This verse describes the abode of Hell (Jahannam) as the destination for those who disbelieve, emphasizing that it is a terrible place of residence. The phrase 'what an evil repository' highlights the severity and permanence of this dwelling for the disbelievers.
